renderDetails.messageTitle: Message from Network & Passive Income Optimizer (self)

content:
All 4 optimizations handled. Here's the summary:

## 1. FAH cpus=12 + on-idle=false ✅
FAH v8 has no `<power>` XML element — it's a cloud account setting. Applied equivalent CLI-configurable max settings:
- cpus: 11 → 12 (max)
- on-idle: false (folds always, not just at idle)
Service restarted, both WU1 (CPU 11%) and WU2 (GPU 8%) resumed immediately.

## 2. openhuman-core Rebuild 🔄 In Progress
- git pull --rebase: ✅ 12 new commits pulled (→ v0.57.40)
- docker build: Running (Step 5/28, Rust build ~5-15 min)
- After build completes user should run: `cd ~/Desktop/Projects/openhuman && docker compose up -d --force-recreate openhuman-core`

## 3. Pawns.app Offerwalls ⚠️ Dashboard-only
pawns-cli binary has NO offerwall flags (-email/-password/-device/-accept-tos only). Must be enabled at: pawns.app/dashboard → Offerwalls tab

## 4. Honeygain Jump ⚠️ Dashboard-only  
honeygain binary has NO Jump flag (-email/-pass/-device/-tou-accept only). Must be enabled at: app.honeygain.com → Dashboard → Jump toggle

## Stack Status
| Service | Status | Change |
|---|---|---|
| fah-client | ✅ Active | cpus 11→12, on-idle=false |
| openhuman-core | ✅ Healthy | Rebuild in progress (0.57.39→0.57.40) |
| honeygain | ✅ Running | No CLI option for Jump |
| pawns-cli | ✅ Running | No CLI option for Offerwalls |

2 manual dashboard actions remain for user:
1. app.honeygain.com → toggle Jump ON
2. pawns.app/dashboard → complete Offerwalls
